The '''''Scythe IV''''' was a [[G1-M4-C Dunelizard fighter]] in service during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was the personal starship of [[Hortrix Steelarm]], a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] working for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. Hortrix Steelarm was killed sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] when the ''Scythe IV'' was destroyed by a pilot working for the rival [[Valarian Syndicate]].<ref name="SWG:Ttgp" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Scythe IV'' appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:Ttgp" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The ''Scythe IV'' was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:Ttgp" />
